subject: Call for proposals — internal round (deadline 20 Oct)
body:
Dear Sean,

The internal research round is open. Please submit a one-page intent by 20 October 2026 17:00. Budget ceiling is HKD 65,000.

Grants Office

subject: Re: Call for proposals — internal round
body:
Sean — I can co-PI the Meridian extension. Shall we split the budget HKD 40k/25k? Let me know today so I can file my form.

Alice

subject: Re: Call for proposals — DEADLINE EXTENDED to 27 Oct
body:
Update: the deadline moves to 27 October 2026 17:00. The earlier 20 October date no longer applies. No further extensions.

Grants Office

body:
FYI only — I am not applying this cycle. No reply needed.

Bob

subject: Sync on Project Meridian — propose Monday?
body:
Hi Sean,

Shall we schedule a Meridian sync for Monday 14 Sep at 3pm in my office? I want to align on the venue shortlist.

Alice

subject: Re: Sync on Project Meridian — propose Monday?
body:
Monday 3pm clashes with the faculty meeting. Can we move to Tuesday 15 Sep at 10am? Same room works.

Bob

subject: Re: Sync on Project Meridian — CONFIRMED Tue 15 Sep 10:00
body:
Tuesday 15 Sep 10:00 is locked in room 723. Monday 3pm is cancelled. See you then.

Alice

subject: Re: Sync on Project Meridian
body:
Adding the venue shortlist to the shared drive ahead of the meeting. No action from you.

Carol

subject: Review request: manuscript JSR-2026-0912
body:
Dear Dr Yeung,

We invite you to review manuscript JSR-2026-0912. Please confirm within 5 days; the review is due 15 October 2026.

Editor

subject: Re: Review request: manuscript JSR-2026-0912
body:
I reviewed this one last cycle and flagged a statistical issue. Happy to share notes if you accept.

Grace

subject: Reminder: JSR-2026-0912 review due 15 Oct
body:
A reminder that your review of JSR-2026-0912 is due 15 October 2026. This is an automated reminder.

Editor

subject: Draft chapters 3-4 for your comments
body:
Prof Yeung,

I attached draft chapters 3-4 of my thesis. Could you send comments by Friday 18 Sep? I need them before the panel meeting.

Henry

subject: Re: Draft chapters 3-4
body:
One correction: the panel moved to 25 Sep, so comments by 23 Sep would be fine. Ignore the earlier Friday date.

Henry

subject: Invite: give the October systems seminar?
body:
Sean,

Would you give the systems seminar on 12 October? 45 minutes plus questions. Let me know and I will book the room.

Raymond

subject: Re: Invite: give the October systems seminar?
body:
If you accept, I can cover your tutorial that morning. Say the word.

Alice

Dear Sean,

Quotation QT-5512 for the GPU workstation is HKD 48,900, valid 30 days. A formal invoice follows on order.

CloudNorth Sales

This is eligible under the equipment line. Submit the quote when you place the order.

Dear colleagues,

Dean's Office

Grace

The data sharing agreement is now signed by both parties. Filing this for your records; no action required.

This week: three funding calls, a long read on open science, and the annual review. To unsubscribe, use the link at the foot.

We blocked a login from an unrecognised device. If this was not you, reset your password from the portal. Automated alert.

Security

Hi Sean, can we do the Brightwave kickoff Wednesday 3pm? Agenda: scope, timeline, contacts.

David

body:
Wednesday works. I will bring the analytics lead. Please share the scope deck beforehand.

Marcus

Sean, the Northwind milestone cleared. Raise invoice INV-2291 for HKD 12,400 and send it to Elena.

We need to add a reporting dashboard. Can you send a revised estimate by Thursday? This changes the timeline.

Agreed we should quote it separately. Do not absorb it into the fixed fee. Send the estimate to Marcus.

David

Comments in the doc. Two are blocking: the ID scheme and the retention policy. Can we resolve by Monday?

Elena

I can take the retention policy. You handle the ID scheme.

David

The Brightwave retainer renews 30 Sep. Do we auto-renew or renegotiate? Need your call.

Ivy
